Real excerpts of wago.tools DB2 tables (live build, read 29 Oct 2026) for lib/loot.js nativeEmb(): the rows that make items "embellished
by themselves" (ItemLimitCategory 512 "Embellished" on ItemSparse.LimitCategory, or bonus list 8960 = ItemBonus type 35 value 512 in their
bonus tree), plus a few unrelated rows. ItemSparse keeps only the 4 columns nativeEmb reads.
